clinical_examples.title: Chest Pain — Ruled-Out PE vs. GERD
clinical_examples.state: 54yo F presented to ED with substernal burning chest discomfort after dinner. Given recent 6-hour flight, CTA chest was obtained and showed NO pulmonary embolism and no aortic dissection. High-sensitivity troponin T was <6 ng/L at 0h and 3h; ECG normal sinus rhythm. Symptoms resolved completely after viscous lidocaine and IV pantoprazole. Discharged on daily omeprazole.

questions.prompt: Does this note confirm a diagnosis of pulmonary embolism?
Most likely final diagnosis explaining this visit?

clinical_examples.title: Cardiac Asthma vs. Decompensated HFrEF
clinical_examples.state: 71yo M with childhood asthma (no inhaler use in 15 yrs), HTN, and ischemic cardiomyopathy (EF 25%) admitted for 4 days of worsening orthopnea, 3-pillow sleep, and 4 kg weight gain. Exam: JVP 14 cm, bibasilar crackles, 2+ pitting edema to knees; mild expiratory wheeze ('cardiac asthma'). Two albuterol nebulizers in ED gave no relief. BNP 2,650 pg/mL. CXR: vascular congestion and Kerley B lines.

questions.prompt: Primary driver of this patient's acute dyspnea?
Is IV loop diuretic therapy clinically indicated?

clinical_examples.title: Metformin-Associated Lactic Acidosis vs. DKA
clinical_examples.state: 66yo F with T2DM on metformin 1000 mg BID and CKD3b had 3 days of gastroenteritis with poor PO intake. Labs: Na 138, K 5.4, Cl 98, HCO3 10, BUN 58, Cr 4.1 (baseline 1.5), glucose 114 mg/dL, beta-hydroxybutyrate 0.3 mmol/L (normal), venous pH 7.16, serum lactate 10.2 mmol/L. Urine ketones negative.

questions.prompt: Which metabolic emergency best explains these labs?
Do the laboratory values support diabetic ketoacidosis?

clinical_examples.title: Unbiopsied Pulmonary Nodule — Refusing to Guess Stage
clinical_examples.state: 59yo M with 35 pack-year smoking history had a screening low-dose chest CT showing a 1.8 cm spiculated right upper lobe nodule. Pulmonology referral placed for PET-CT and biopsy. No pathology or mediastinal lymph node sampling has been performed yet.

questions.prompt: What is the confirmed TNM stage of lung cancer based on this note?

clinical_examples.title: Sepsis-3 Septic Shock — Single-Sentence Flip
clinical_examples.state:
Case A (Positive): 64yo F with E. coli bacteremia. Despite 30 mL/kg IV crystalloid, MAP remains 56 mmHg requiring norepinephrine at 12 mcg/min. Repeat lactate is 4.6 mmol/L.
Case B (Negative): Same patient — following 30 mL/kg crystalloid, MAP improved to 78 mmHg with no vasopressors required. Repeat lactate normalized to 1.2 mmol/L.

questions.prompt: Case A — Meets Sepsis-3 septic shock criteria (vasopressor + lactate > 2)?
Case B — Meets Sepsis-3 septic shock criteria (vasopressor + lactate > 2)?

clinical_examples.title: Multi-Clause Clinical Trial Exclusion Trap
clinical_examples.state:
Trial Criteria: Adults >=18y with symptomatic HFrEF (LVEF <=40%) on stable GDMT. Exclusions: eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73m2, active malignancy receiving chemotherapy, or pregnancy.
Patient: 69yo M with NYHA III HFrEF (LVEF 30%) on carvedilol and sacubitril-valsartan, currently undergoing FOLFOX chemotherapy for stage III colon cancer, eGFR 28 mL/min/1.73m2.

questions.prompt: Is this patient eligible to enroll in the clinical trial?
